summary: Approved as a polished typography example: both requested text strings are spelled correctly and fully readable, the ampersand and date punctuation are stable, the paper tag and charcoal notebook form a coherent restrained composition, and the window light reveals believable paper, metal, and cover texture.
knownLimitations: The main KITE & ANVIL name wraps across two lines instead of remaining on one line.
The framing is closer and more photographic than a flat graphic label study.
